file-name.purpose: Measured card identity with middle ellipsis.

panel-title.purpose: Face-workspace subsections and local face-index status.

shadows.name: minimap-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating camera surface above the graph.

shadows.name: selected-video-glow
shadows.value: SVG SourceAlpha Gaussian blur stdDeviation=5; flood opacity=.38; amber #ee9a3f or blue #70b8de; merged behind SourceGraphic
shadows.purpose: Reinforce selected and video cards without removing the stroke.

shadows.name: context-menu-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate temporary graph actions from the canvas.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honor reduced motion in the graph; no decorative motion token is established.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Compact graph actions and camera controls.

components.css: .ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940cc;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer;}.ds-quiet:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px;}.ds-quiet:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

components.name: Find Similar Button
components.description: The muted warm action in the file inspector.
components.html: <button class="ds-similar" type="button">Find similar</button>
components.css: .ds-similar{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940cc;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer;border-color:#a37a49;background:#52402d;color:#f5d8af}.ds-similar:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-similar:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px;}.ds-similar:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

components.name: Active Preview Toggle

components.css: .ds-preview{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940cc;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;padding:6px 10px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer;border-color:#899eb1;background:#3a4652}.ds-preview svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-preview:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-preview:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Minimum Similarity
components.description: Threshold label and native select as one compact control.
components.css: .ds-threshold{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:4px 6px 4px 10px;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;color:#eef2f6;background:#30363dde;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px}.ds-threshold select{font:inherit;background:#252a30;color:#f1f4f7;border:0;border-radius:4px;padding:4px}.ds-threshold select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Zoom Range

components.name: Camera Navigation

components.css: .ds-file-selected{cursor:pointer;outline:none;background:#202429}.ds-file-selected:hover .ds-card{stroke-opacity:1}.ds-file-selected:focus-visible .ds-card{stroke:#ffc079;stroke-width:3}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-file-selected .ds-card{fill:Canvas;stroke:CanvasText;filter:none}.ds-file-selected text{fill:CanvasText}}

components.name: Minimap Container
components.description: A collapsible glass camera surface with a restrained shadow; schematic nodes carry no file data.
components.html: Minimap
components.css: .ds-minimap{width:160px;background:#282e35ed;border:1px solid #56616d;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #00000040;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.ds-minimap summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 10px;color:#d7e0e9;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-minimap summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-minimap summary svg{height:14px;width:14px;stroke:#b2bfcc;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5}.ds-minimap:not([open]) summary svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}.ds-minimap summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px;}.ds-map{display:block;width:calc(100% - 16px);height:105px;margin:0 8px;border-radius:3px;background:#1c2025}

components.name: Graph Omnibar
components.description: Filename filtering and Enter-triggered semantic highlighting within the loaded canvas.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-omnibar">Search this graph</label><input id="ds-omnibar" type="search" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Filename filter · Enter for semantic search"><button type="submit" aria-label="Semantic search"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5"/><path d="M12 12L17 17"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;width:360px;max-width:100%;min-width:180px;gap:5px;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;background:#252b32;padding-left:10px}.ds-search-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;color:#eef2f6;background:transparent;border:0;padding:7px 0;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;caret-color:#f0a048}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:#aebbc8}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-search button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:34px;min-height:34px;padding:6px;color:#e1e7ee;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.ds-search button:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px}.ds-search svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

components.name: Modality Chips
components.description: Quiet modality filters with amber pressed state; Faces opens observation selection when the local worker and models are ready.
components.css: .ds-modalities{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-modalities button{border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:16px;color:#bfcbd6;background:#293039;padding:5px 10px;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-modalities button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:#f3d6b3;background:#483827;border-color:#d29b5d}.ds-modalities button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57;color:#f1f4f7}.ds-modalities button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px}.ds-modalities button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

components.css: .ds-inspector{width:360px;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px;background:#252b32ed;color:#eef2f6;border-left:1px solid #414952;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;scrollbar-color:#687785 #252b32;scrollbar-width:thin}.ds-inspector-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-inspector-heading h3{flex:1;margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-inspector button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:30px;padding:4px 7px;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940cc;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer}.ds-inspector .ds-close{width:34px;min-height:34px;padding:6px}.ds-close svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-evidence-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:20px 0 12px}.ds-evidence-heading h4{flex:1;margin:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.ds-inspector dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px 12px;margin:0 0 14px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.ds-inspector dt{color:#b4bec8}.ds-inspector dd{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;user-select:text;white-space:pre-wrap}.ds-inspector details{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #414952;padding-top:12px}.ds-inspector summary{color:#d3dde6;cursor:pointer}.ds-inspector button:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-inspector button:focus-visible,.ds-inspector summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-inspector{width:min(360px,calc(100% - 24px))}}

components.name: Confirmed Link and Review Actions
components.description: Schematic confirmed curve/pill and local review actions; actual scores and modality icons come from indexed evidence.
components.html: Verification is your local assessment, not an automated finding.
components.css: .ds-review{color:#b4bec8;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;line-height:1.5}.ds-link{cursor:pointer;outline:none}.ds-hit{fill:none;stroke:transparent;stroke-width:18;pointer-events:stroke}.ds-curve{fill:none;stroke:#83cda2;stroke-width:3;stroke-opacity:.95}.ds-pill{fill:#293039;stroke:#83cda2;stroke-width:.8}.ds-link text{fill:#d2dbe4;font:11px "Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-link:focus-visible .ds-pill{stroke:#ffc079;stroke-width:3}.ds-verification{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}.ds-verification button{min-height:34px;padding:6px 10px;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940cc;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer}.ds-verification .ds-confirm{border-color:#628c73;color:#b8e5ca;background:#2c4236}.ds-verification .ds-reject{border-color:#a37572;color:#f0cfcd;background:#483334}.ds-verification button:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-verification .ds-confirm:hover{background:#2c4236}.ds-verification .ds-reject:hover{background:#483334}.ds-verification button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:2px}.ds-verification button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.ds-review p{margin-top:12px}

components.name: Local Face Index Controls
components.description: Inspector-toned local indexing status, explicit start/pause actions, and native device choice. Counts and active device come from the worker at runtime.
components.html:
Face index is ready to start

YuNet + SFace processes photos and sampled video frames locally.
components.css: .ds-face-index{padding:12px 18px;background:#252b32;color:#eef2f6;border-bottom:1px solid #414952;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif}.ds-face-index strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.ds-face-index p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#b4bec8;line-height:1.5}.ds-face-index-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}.ds-face-index-controls label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:#b4bec8}.ds-face-index-controls select,.ds-face-index-controls button{color:#e1e7ee;background:#323940;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;font:inherit}.ds-face-index-controls button{cursor:pointer}.ds-face-index-controls button:hover:not(:disabled),.ds-face-index-controls select:hover{background:#424c57}.ds-face-index-controls :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:3px}.ds-face-index-controls :disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}

components.name: Face Observation Selector
components.description: Numbered cyan source boxes and amber source selection pair with real local crops. This schematic snippet omits media; runtime crops use indexed bounding boxes on the actual source frame.
components.html:
Local source image

Choose one face in the picture or below.
components.css: .ds-face-selector{color:#eef2f6;font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif}.ds-face-stage{position:relative;min-height:150px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#181c21}.ds-face-stage-note{display:block;padding:10px;color:#b4bec8;font-size:11px}.ds-face-box{position:absolute;display:block;min-width:0;min-height:0;margin:0;padding:0;width:42px;height:54px;top:65px;border:2px solid #77acc5;background:#77acc50a;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}.ds-face-box-first{left:28%}.ds-face-box-selected{left:58%}.ds-face-box:hover,.ds-face-box[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#f0a048;background:#f0a04814}.ds-face-box span{position:absolute;top:-20px;left:-2px;min-width:20px;padding:0 3px;color:#202429;background:#77acc5;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;font-size:11px;line-height:17px}.ds-face-box[aria-pressed="true"] span{background:#f0a048}.ds-face-selector p{margin:10px 0;color:#b4bec8;line-height:1.5}.ds-face-choices{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-face-choice{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px;color:#e1e7ee;background:#2b3036;border:1px solid #505962;border-radius:8px;font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Noto Sans",sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;cursor:pointer}.ds-face-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#f0a048;background:#483827;color:#f5d8af}.ds-face-choice:hover:not(:disabled){background:#424c57}.ds-face-crop{display:block;flex:none;width:62px;height:62px;background:#181c21;border-radius:5px}.ds-face-selector :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0a048;outline-offset:3px}.ds-face-selector :disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}@media (forced-colors:active){.ds-face-box,.ds-face-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:Highlight}}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Graphite, Glass, Amber/Cyan"**

This system applies to DigUp's Tauri graph workspace, its face-investigation and People extensions, and their active shell colors. It records the implemented interpretation of the user's pinned dark canvas reference. The desktop launcher, normal search layout, setup flow, and other native surfaces retain their incumbent design; this is a scoped workspace system.

A restrained graphite canvas supports compact translucent horizontal file cards. Amber identifies the selected file and emphasizes its unverified incident links; cyan distinguishes video cards. Green and muted red record the operator's confirmed and rejected link states. Authored outline icons and actual local thumbnails carry file identity. The canvas remains dense enough for exploration while the overlay inspector supplies readable file and match evidence.

Face investigation reuses that graphite material, native type, quiet controls, and warm selection. A large source photograph or sampled video frame carries numbered cyan face boxes; the selected observation and crop adopt amber. Actual face crops, file names, cosine values, and reported video times make candidate review concrete. The indexing strip and persistent candidate-language footer remain part of the working surface.

People extends that working material into a compact label directory, observation list, and media preview. Cyan identifies the current person and inspected observation; separate native checkboxes identify the observations targeted by the bottom action bar. Assigned, Suggestions, Excluded, and Needs review remain explicit text groups. Local label changes expose a wrapping Undo strip, and persistent copy distinguishes the operator's labels from verified identities.
keyCharacteristics: A world-anchored grid and stable file neighborhoods.
Glass plates with small rounded corners and restrained state glows.
Native sans typography, measured filename truncation, and modality/cosine pills.
Visible search/index context, graph search and filters, a collapsible evidence inspector, and an operable minimap.
A source-led face workspace with local indexing controls, observation crops, paged candidates, and media evidence.
A People directory with explicit review groups, independent preview and bulk selection, local label forms, and visible undo.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: In the graph, amber follows the selected card, active unverified links, and a requested shortest path; cyan identifies unselected video cards. In Faces, amber follows the selected source observation, while cyan identifies available face boxes and the active candidate row. Confirmed links retain green during ordinary selection; rejected links use muted red only when explicitly shown. Pair review colors with line patterns and inspector text.

rules.name: The Separate Selection Rule
rules.body: In People and face-result lists, the cyan row highlight chooses a preview. A separate checkbox chooses an observation for label actions. A preview highlight never implies that its checkbox is checked; Assigned and Suggestions remain separate labelled groups.

rules.name: The Filename Rule
rules.body: Preserve the filename's beginning and ending when truncating. Keep full paths available through the card title and inspector instead of shrinking the type.

rules.name: The Topology Rule
rules.body: Force positions communicate connections, not measured similarity distance. Timeline positions encode modification dates except for explicit pins. Show only expanded neighborhoods, retain the (120-file) cap, and do not promise planar routing for cyclic graphs.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep default cards restrained. Selection and video state may glow; the ordinary canvas remains low contrast.

dos: **Do** keep this visual system scoped to the graph, face-investigation, and People workspaces.
**Do** preserve amber source selection and the scoped cyan video, face-box, and candidate meanings.
**Do** pair confirmed/rejected colors with line patterns and readable local-review status.
**Do** retain world-anchored grid, stable existing-node positions, and measured filename truncation.
**Do** use actual local thumbnails and authored SVG icons.
**Do** keep search/index context visible, inspector details scrollable, and camera controls keyboard accessible.
**Do** preserve RU/EN labels, reduced-motion behavior, and forced-colors fallbacks.
**Do** use real face crops, numbered source boxes, reported video times, and explicit paged candidate counts.
**Do** retain local indexing/device status, visible dark scrollbars, and candidate-not-identity language in Faces.
**Do** keep preview highlights independent of checked observations, with the selected count and label actions in the People bottom bar.
**Do** retain explicit Assigned, Suggestions, Excluded, and Needs review groups, wrapping local-label forms, and the separate Undo strip.
**Do** keep bulk scope visible, including unloaded matches and the source when All matches + source is active.
donts: **Don't** extend the graph palette into the desktop launcher or normal search as an implicit rebrand.
**Don't** encode cosine as physical distance or imply that only expanded links form a complete global graph.
**Don't** replace real scores or thumbnails with decorative fabricated data.
**Don't** present cosine as probability, an exact EXIF-date match as provenance proof, or unavailable analysis as detected evidence.
**Don't** use selection glow as the sole focus or state indicator.
**Don't** present local person labels or unconfirmed suggestions as verified identities.
